Solve the steady-state oil flow

Inject air bubbles at the return

Swap in an Air-X return filter

Downsize the tank

Analyse the smaller Air-X tank

Compare the deaeration curves

CFD computes the oil velocity in the original tank. The jet from the standard return filter runs along the tank floor straight to the suction.

Bubbles from 0.1 to 1.0 mm enter with the return oil, carried by the flow and lifted by buoyancy. The jet carries 36% of them to the pump.

The standard filter is replaced by an Air-X filter with an integrated diffuser and coalescence screen.

With the return flow calmed, the extra oil that only slowed the jet is no longer needed. The tank shrinks by 25%.

The same bubbles are injected again. Micro-bubbles merge on the screen into larger bubbles that rise straight to the surface.

The Air-X tank deaerates 96% of the air with 25% less oil. The original tank reached 64%.
